review_description: It was a good process, Alex was helpful and met me more than halfway.
I  am happy they provided the best inverter in the market with reasonable prices.

Very short notice of installation due to a cancellation, but once organised on my part , the panels were installed in less than a day. The electrical system took a little longer due to extra work on the switchboard, but once finally completed the whole system was up and running in less than an hour.So far so good, but only running one month, so will give it 6 months before I can comment on its effectiveness and performance.Thanks Allan

The sales / quoting process was thorough and detailed.The installation went very well. The team were friendly, efficient and cleaned up.The cutomer service was caring and responsive. Questions were followed up and there was genuine concern that the entire installation process was done to a high standard.

Very good experience and very good Salesman.Came to give quote very quickly and installation was not too long after that. Answered all my questions along the way. Had a little issue getting the data to display on the app but managed to figure it out with a little tinkering.

Went with Advanced Solar Technology because Alex was the only person who came to the house to do the quote, and the quote was competitive with the other quotes (got 4).  Had the install last Tuesday, tradesman were professional, and cleaned up afterwards.everything seemed to go well, just waiting for the Western Power hook up.

The install happened 2 weeks earlier than planned, it was installed quickly and the installers were clean and tidy  and they didn’t dent out new tin roof. The performance from our 24 panels is as planned. Great job.
Excellent experience with Advanced Solar Technology. Great customer service and installation and the salesperson's knowledge was exceptional.

I'm overseas at the moment and this whole process has been done from remote. Advanced solar quoting process started with a video conference and discussion resulting with a tailored quote specific to my needs and no back a forth. Installation went through with no surprises, looking forward to seeing the system when we return home soon. Grid connection was organised and photos from our tenant showed a neat and tidy installation.

Bettered other quotes  by far , installed on time and with minimum fuss . I felt the after care service and especially about what needed to happen with western power and when was lacking a bit .I expected a bit more checking in once installed but to be fair they did reply if I contacted them with any questionsOverall glad I went with advanced sonarThanksMaree
Advanced Solar Technology were helpful, informative, easy to deal with and gave the best price. Recommended.

Everything from start to finish with this install was perfect. We were incredibly happy with Alex and his team from the initial quote and system design, through to the install and follow up after the install. I'd highly recommend Advanced Solar Technology to anyone.

Absolutely thrilled with the entire experience. Solar Quotes guided us to a list of installers, and after careful consideration, Advanced Solar Technology emerged as the clear choice, offering the best price for top-notch components. Their commitment to service was evident as they took the extra step of conducting an in-person assessment at our home, demonstrating a level of dedication beyond the norm.Once we confirmed our decision, the scheduling was swift, with installation completed in less than 4 hours by competent, polite, and professional installers.The comprehensive package not only covered power generation but also included details on supply costs, addressing our daily expenses. Throughout the process, any concerns or questions were met with prompt and thorough responses from the Advanced Solar Technology team. I am genuinely impressed with both the system's performance and the outstanding support provided. Without hesitation, I would wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and family. They've exceeded our expectations, and we couldn't be happier with the results.

Solar quotes gave us a few installers to contact. Advanced Solar had the best price for the quality of the components and showed up at the house to have a look rather than just sending an email.After confirming, we were booked in under two weeks.The install itself was done in under 4 hours which was a welcome surprise, usually it takes all day.Power generation and supply (how much you pay per day) were both included.Any issues I've had have been answered quickly my the Advanced team. So far very happy with the performance of the system and the support from the team.

Advanced Solar went out of their way to install the system in a creative way to get around some tricky bits. They spent the time to educate and were very quick. I will use them again for a battery in the future when prices come down.We installed a Delta invertor which is a very soild, compact system. My only recommendation to Delta is that they need to get a better App. Their app often requires you to logout or shut the app down to get it to work. It also only has production data. To see consumption requires me to switch to a second app (PowerPal). Not super user friendly, but I am able to get the data. I hope Delta updates their app to a more professional and polished state one day. They make great invertors though.

Very easy dealing with the company from the start. Quoting process was good, simple to understand. Installation was done very well and the workmen cleaned up afterwards.Some issues connecting my mobile to the grid but I'm still working on it.

From the initial consult to post installation, Alex and the team from Advanced solar technology were fantastic and glad we were recommend them from Solarquotes.The system is perfect for our specific needs and very happy with the results.

Alex came to our unit to explain what he could offer. He is very knowledgeable, friendly and "down to earth."I was pleasantly surprised that the system he suggested was well priced, he knew exactly what I needed.Installation went ahead within three weeks and it all went smoothly. The system is up and running, now I'm just waiting for more sunshine so that it can really give the savings it is capable of.I would have no hesitation in recommending  Alex / Advanced Solar Technology to anyone looking to install solar panels and/or battery in Perth.
Sales and quoting was fine.Took some effort on my part to get a commitment for installation date. Several phone calls.Customer service was good after installation was achieved.

On 20 Oct quoted to provide "supply and install 5kW Solar system 2-6 Weeks to installation", with additions such as upgraded power board and a battery. Almost 6 weeks later, there was a delay in regulator approvals and he suggested cancelling the initial application and resubmitting for solar only (no battery) to take advantage of rebates changing at end of December – this involved phone calls from us to Synergy.  This was done and installation occurred a week after. The installer indicated that the director would be around the next day to take photos and confirm satisfactory installation and the meter would be changed. While Western Power completed the meter activities, we did not see director.They were then responsible for resubmitting an application, this time for the addition of the battery alone which they said they had in supply and set aside for us already. We requested an update on the status of the battery installation via email on 11 and 17 Jan. There is no history of an email response to either.  In early Feb phone contact was made with them and photos of the meter were sent in response to this via SMS. There was one instance where a call from them did not come through to our phone and thinking it was a problem with our provider, we called to investigate in case this was the reason for the lack of contact – it was not. 2 days later they asked us to authorise them to speak to Synergy on our behalf regarding solar issues.  This was authorised with Synergy for the period 15-28 Feb and for solar issues only.Alex cancelled the battery application as Advanced Solar Technologies had put in wrong information (API cloud instead of meter solution according to a text from Alex on 16 Feb). This change cost us more time.On 9 Mar, having heard nothing further from them, we called Synergy to check status of application.  It had been completed and approved by Synergy but was waiting on the Western Power application that was to be submitted by Advanced Solar Tech. A call to WP indicated that they had not received any application.  This in fact was multiple calls to both Synergy and Western Power, logged at our end. A request via SMS for an update from AST met with no response.On 5 April we again called Synergy and Western Power to confirm status of the application – still waiting on the application being presented to Western Power. At this stage, without any contact from them since 9 March, we sent the following email:“Hi,We are beyond being frustrated by the service you are providing with regard to the installation of a battery.  We have missed the window to further defray our power costs during peak summer time.We have spent hours and hours of time confirming with both Synergy and Western Power the status of the application prior to communication with you.  Out most recent text message of 9 March requested an update, given that we are still waiting on the application to go to Western Power (Synergy have allocated a reference number for this purpose).  You did not extend the courtesy of an update or even a reply.A phone call today to Western Power confirmed that no application has been made in the intervening period since 9 March.This exercise has cost us approximately 8 hours in following up activities that should have occurred seamlessly, with minimal involvement from us.After much frustration and wasted time, we are cancelling our battery order with you. P… is contacting the third-party organisation that referred you to provide feedback on our overall experience.Yours sincerely”This prompted multiple phone calls from them during dinner time and early next morning. A voicemail was left apologising and offering to fix with compensation for lost battery use in summer and our time.  We responded by email acknowledging calls and message and requesting that the offer be put in an email as we no longer wanted phone contact with them that further interrupted our time.There has been no subsequent email reply from them, nor offer in writing to fix the poor service, just more of the same lack of timely response.We are very disappointed in the service that cost us more in time spent following up, frustration and lost opportunity to take advantage of summer sun with the battery. A lesson in communication and follow-up.

Alex from advanced solar technology came promptly once we had contacted them for a quote. He was so nice and explained about all the different systems available. He was happy to have my electrician son in law present to ask all the technical questions I didn't know to ask. Also impressed that they donated our old panels to a third world country. Michelle did all the paperwork with our service provider which was great and organised the grid connection. Our system was installed very quickly and they were very efficient and the electrician who came explained about how the inverter worked and also the powerpal app that was installed as well. I would highly recommend Advanced solar technology. We already saved about $200 on our latest bill with only 11 days of solar panels in the billing period. So very happy. Also they charged very little to remove our existing system that was no longer working.

I can’t fault the price, install etc but after our inverter failed and inspected as being fault we heard nothing for 8 weeks on a replacement item and had to follow up with several texts and phone calls. Disappointed.
We received good advice, personal attention to detail followed by an easy and seamless install. Thanks

We chose Advanced Solar Technology as they were the middle priced quote of the three with highly rated components. The installation was done within days of placing the order however the final connection by the WA energy supplier, Western Power was problematic, taking a month to be completed. Once Alex from Advanced Solar Technology was aware of the failures by Western Power, he personally visited us twice and got Western Power moving quickly. The system now works and we are happy so far.

I am so happy that we selected Advanced Solar Technology to install our solar panel system.  We had reviewed four installers and Advanced Solar Technology were by the best.Alex was personable and did not pressure us.  We had asked each installer if they could install the solar panels by a certain date as we were going overseas.  Only AST were confident enough to commit to the date and they delivered on time.  I enthusiastically endorse Alex and his team.

I checked many systems and compared prices from more than Solar quotes 3suggestions and Advanced were competitive with all of them. A few days before the installation  I was phoned and asked if i wanted an Electrical board upgrade  for $1200 extra which i felt pressured into accepting! Why was this not brought up when the salesman looked at the Board? The Installers arrived on time and installed the system .After which they hastily tried to explain to me how it works, This felt very rushed to me as they wanted to get away. My recycle bin was overflowing and a couple of boxes left for me to get rid of. As i was still unsure if the system was working correctly i phoned Advanced and we worked it out that every thing is working well.

Process from first phone call, to quote, to meeting through to installation was seamless. All explained clearly. Friendly and professional, all you can ask for. Haven't had the first bill yet so will update when I see if it saves money etc, but looks to be running as it should.Cheers Matt
We are very pleased with the service and professionalism of Alex and the team at Advanced Solar Technology. Glad we picked them.

So far so good; quotation was good; Alex came out and spoke to us; ran through the offering; seemed to keep the bs to a minimum.Installation was quick and simple with minimal wait time or interference to us.Currently waiting on Synergy coming out to do the final connection so that system is live.

Alex listened to what we wanted explained exactly how the system would work and sat with us for an hour to work out the best solution for our power needs and to enable our desire to expand on the system at a a later date. The install was agreed for a few weeks and was done on the day agreed.  System up and running and we are happy with the entire process
Clear early response by Alex,  open to discussing customer requirements and providing sound selection advice.Install shortly after sign up (no delays).

Very knowledgeable salesperson, replies quickly with all the info needed. Didn’t push the sale just answered questions promptly. Installation was quick and efficient, installers easy to deal with. So far we are very happy with our product!

Wasn't happy on his original quote he'd say he would have the inverter installed the next day, this took 3 weeks and after quite a lot of phone calls he never got back to me only on the day of installation.  the installers were punctual only took 15 minutes.

Personal visit and explanation preferred by the supplier in contrast to emailing long and detailed quotes, terms, etc and phone calls.Certainly not the cheapest installation, however the rated quality of the equipment being installed, down to earth (no car salesman speak) approach, prompt, respectful communications and fast installation promised (and delivered) got them over the line.  Happy with the installation. Looks professional. No broken tiles, no rubbish / offcuts, etc left lying around. ~3.5hr install with only 15-20min power out at connection time. Separate power monitor (PowerPal) connected to our EM1000 smart meter as part of the installation (no additional cost).14 x Old panels and inverter removed for $250 in price paid.

The sales person was informative and answered questions factually and did not react negatively to simple, ill-informed questions.The installation people came on time and were polite.  They tidied up after themselves and explained what the next step would be and what I had to do.the sales person offered to come back and help if I had any problems.Western Power has not yet connected the system but I was very happy with the interaction I had with Advanced Solar Technology.
Alex explained everything very professionally and left us feeling confident in the process and the product.

The selection process for solar was a bit daunting but once we selected Advanced Solar Technology it became much easier. Alex was very helpful and answered all questions. The installation was quick and efficient with little to no fuss. Follow up is hard to say as we’re waiting for our first account since installation, but we are expecting a lovely surprise as our readings are looking positive. Thanks Solar Quotes for putting us in contact.

I organised this for my daughterInstallation went well and was very efficiently doneAll mess was cleaned upConnection to the grid happened about a week laterOnly problem was the Delta invertor's App which is difficult to install . It still hasn't been done due to both parties travelling, but It will happen
In time.Just that Synergy took over 4 weeks to change meter after 4, 5 calls to Synergy and western power, being treated like a football.
Sales man was explained everything very well and gave examples of working systems to sow the savings that can be made.Install was good quick and tidy

Great customer service from the beginning.  Michelle was fantastic calling and setting up the appointment (even when we had to reschedule due to COVID).  Alex was great from the start.  He explained the whole process and how things worked.  He was honest and even when I emailed him further questions, he was on the phone to me straight away, with the answers.  The installers were amazing.  They were friendly and did an excellent job.  They cleaned up after themselves and the workmanship was excellent.    From the initial contact, right through the whole process, I couldn't have asked for better service.  Thanks  Alex and the team, great job!
Install was handled well and installers helped me register my system on line so I can get access to performance details

Very impressed with the sales style, quote and customer service. Alex was friendly and approachable. He explained everything clearly and the price was reasonable.Installers were efficient, but could do with being trained in basic waste management. All waste was dumped straight into the recycling bin. Luckily I noticed and made them sort it. Likely they do it at every installation they attend.

All three sales people that quoted really knew their stuff and didn't try any hard sales routines.  They provided lots of alternatives and backed it up with quality information.  Tough choice between the three but went with Advanced Solar because they've been around a long time and the price seemed very reasonable for a mid range product.

Alex from Advanced Solar Technology was so helpful and informative in our quoting process.His price for product was super competitive and he is so friendly.The installers were quick and professional. We had bad weather on the day of the installation and half way through I heard Alex’s voice outside - he’d swing past to ensure his installation team were all ok - a sign of a great business owner and employer.I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this company.
Alex was punctual, knowledgeable and easy to communicate with.Installation was clean and tidy, despite some space limitations in the meterbox.
On time, worked efficiently and cleaned up after themselves.  Friendly staff.
Installation was prompt and efficient. Great team to work with from beginning to end.

During quoting process I had all my questions answered and installation was smooth even though our roof is a bit tricky to work with.Customer service has been great, they were very helpful with organising grid connection and explaining how to use production & consumption monitoring.

The whole process was a breeze. After an enquiry with SolarQuotes, Alex from Advanced Solar Technology came around to the house and talked us through the system and where to install it. He was clearly passionate and knowledgeable, and with his quote being line-ball with others, it was his enthusiasm, and being a fellow Tesla owner, that tipped the scales in his favour.Installation was in less than two weeks from the get-go, even though it was in the summer holiday period. Installation was completed efficiently and effectively over the course of a morning (to beat the 42 degrees heat of a Perth afternoon). Everything is working fine and the Tesla is running on sunshine. Happy campers. Would I recommend Advanced Solar Technology to others? Absolutely.

Alex owns the company and came to my house to explain what he could offer. He answered my questions and the price was competitive. The panels and inverter are producing at 100% of the expected output and from installation and commissioning have been flawless. The installation team were efficient and friendly. Incredibly they worked in 43 degree heat on our tin roof and completed the installation in just a few hours. The monitoring software apps give me a detailed view of power produced and power consumed from the grid. All up I’m very happy with all aspects of the purchase. I would definitely recommend AST. We paid $200 extra to have our old 1.5kw system removed and recycled. Alex sends the panels to South Africa where every part is reused down to the glass which is cleaned and used as windows in the townships.

We received quotes from 3 companies promptly and professionally. Advanced Solar's quote was not the cheapest, but they had stock and were able to install within a couple of weeks compared with a couple of months from the competitors.Alex was able to show me other installations that they had done in my area and how the systems were performing. Michelle was highly efficient with the billing and organising the grid connection which went flawlessly,Alex showed me the advantages of using the Powerpal app, which I now use regularly to monitor and regulate our household power consumption. I haven't received an electricity bill since the installation, but if PowerPal is correct, the solar panels are reducing my daily electricity costs from $10 to $5, with air conditioning being the biggest user of electricity in my home.The installation went very well. It was over 40C when the guys were working on the roof but they didn't cut any corners and left the place clean and tidy.I bought a Delta H5A inverter and it is now working well although I mucked up the first attempt to connect to it using the DeltaSolar app due to it having a clunky and non-intuitive interface. Alex was able to figure out what I'd done wrong and referred me to the Delta help line in Melbourne. The Delta rep was very patient and helpful and we sorted out the problem after about an hour.

Alex was very genuine and upfront with his information. He came across as very knowledgeable and helpful. His follow up the day after install, to ensure I fully understood how to use the system and the associated app was very good, he stayed longer to ensure a couple of minor hiccups were dealt with immediately.He made sure I was aware of additional costs (one off) with setting up solar with the electricity provider.The installers were prompt, courteous and had the job done in the anticipated time frame. Clean up after the job was good.To date the system has worked as advertised with no issues. Overall, very happy with the whole process and would happily recommend Alex at Advanced Solar Technology to anyone looking at a solar system

I would not hesitate to recommend this company for solar installation. My only gripe is the Delta solar monitoring was not explained to me, i.e how to connect and use it.Consequently I shut the system down as I tried to set it up and connect. The system was installed 21 Dec 2020. The shutdown was reversed on Christmas eve after being off for three days.

We found Alex knowledgeable and informative during the initial visit and quote process.The install happened sooner that we though it would - pleasantly surprised - and all went smoothly on the day on installation.Only day 2 with the new system. Had a problem with the inverter on day 1 due to my incorrect set up of the app - but Alex came straight out and got it all sorted.Running as it should now without issue.
The company principal handles every part of the business, sales, installer contracting and after sales.  This keeps the price well down and he deals in good products.  After sales takes time.
In person quote. Answered all my questions.  Responsive. Installers left no mess.

After several quotes from the list provided by Solar Quotes we decided to go with Advanced Solar Technology.  It wasn't the cheapest but we were very happy with the process of getting our quote. From the initial phone call to Michelle and the  home visit from Alex, who advised us of several options and helped us make the decision of what system to use.Everything went smoothly and the installation actually happened before the original due date.Installers we punctual and very tidy.We are very happy with the whole process and would not hesitate to recommend Advanced Solar Technology.
Alex was an absolute please to deal with. Dealing with the owner of the business lent an authenticity and trust to the transaction certainly not me by some salespeople out here.

I would like to Thanks Alex the owner of Advanced Solar Technology. He personally came to my house and explained and show me many different solar systems and how it works. Alex is well organized and his installation teams done a great job! I would highly recommend his company to my friends and family.
Timely quote. Reasonable price. Very ett y quick lead time to instal. Instal done quickly with minimal disruption.

Quote and sales process was seamless.They were able to fix problems others could not ( not on this installation ).Installation was excellent, tidy and punctual.Customer service was great.The panels work well. Better than expected in fact.

Sales team were great to speak to, offered the best price and organised everything.The guys who did the install worked well and did not damage anything, but left a box of packaging and packing ties lying around. Ive only had the unit for less than a month, but nothing bad to say about Advanced Solar.
Quoting process was hassle free.Install went well but installers could have been more tidy.Customer service was seamless and system was operating on the same day as install.
Very happy with the whole process, much of which is explained as above
Excellent. Sales person was knowledgable and all good so far.

We had an excellent experience. Alex worked the installation date in and around some other renovations I had scheduled for the house. The output from the system is very impressive, much better than my one at my previous house. Alex came and setup the internet monitoring for me when I was unable to get it working after the internet was finally connected at the house. I would recommend this supplier to anyone great design, install, product quality, and support.

Sales/quoting was very good with a video hookup to ensure I purchase the best system for my needs. Due to the Feb covid lockdown I initially had a Zoom meeting with Alex to discuss solar panels and what I was looking for with my solar install - this was very informative. Alex then came out to inspect the house and we decided on both north and west facing solar panels.The installers arrived exactly when they said they would. They were very tidy taking all the packing away and finished the job in around 4 hours.The customer service has been very good. There was a problem with Synergy not coming out to change the meter but Alex got onto them and all was fixed in a couple of days. Alex also made a follow up phone call  to ensure all went well.
it was a good tidy installation and a good price, was very happy they looked after the grid connection also the after sales service is very good.

Overall I received 5 quotes; 3 via this site, one via personal recommendation and one via the supplier recommendation. I asked questions of nearly everyone and didn't always get the answers. I wanted the usual 6.6/5 setup, but I specifically wanted to be able to have local monitoring. I was not interested in having my data going off to some un-named server overseas. I also wanted consumption and generation monitoring. Lastly I wanted to split the panels across north and west roofs.After a lot of research I decided to go with the Delta H5A-222 inverter, which cut the quotes down a bit as not everyone had access to (or wanted the fuss) of selling the Delta. I cared a bit less about the panels. Only 2 installers did a site visit and only one of those knew the Delta. The combination of a site visit, Delta product knowledge and overall solar system approach meant that AST got my business. None of the others were bad - but they were outclassed or couldn't supply what I wanted (which was not their fault).Currently I am using PowerPal for monitoring, not the consumption monitor that is built in to the Delta.The CT accessory to use the consumption monitoring in the inverter is oddly expensive. I may well go to better monitoring in the future, as that is my longer-term goal.Customer service from AST was very good. Alex from AST was very attentive to my questions and spent plenty of time discussing the setup (not that it was complicated in any way). He was able to demonstrate the monitoring system, live, in the driveway. After the sale and installation, he was open to feedback about the way things had gone.The installation crew were pretty good - they had to come back as the weather was too bad the first time, and I have no problem with that as their safety is paramount. I had a small number of minor niggles about the install, that weren't really a problem to me, but I could see that other people might find them a problem. These were passed on the AST.Grid connection through Synergy was fine. Synergy emailed to advise that they would be moving me to a new system; their contractor turned up (admittedly, unannounced) and changed the meter to the latest version very promptly, and I'm just waiting now on the next bill.Overall, I would have no hesitation recommending AST, especially if like me you wanted to go with the Delta inverter.

Good honest local family owned & run company. Install happened sooner than expected, which was a bonus. Very helpful and friendly service from both husband & wife team. Customer Service was outstanding. Very happy, would highly recommend.Alex was great, came back to make sure I had the app installed correctly to be able to monitor my solar production.Bought extra panels and they made them fit (East/West config).

Great to deal with someone that really knows the technology well and can help us understand how to get the most out of our system. Also great price and install was completed promptly and without issue. Very happy.

Alex provided a middle of the road quote for a 6.6Kw system,& was able to supply local references.The installation was good,& Alex provided a guide on the Delta Inverter & Delta Cloud connection to enable to see Solar production.Also taken into account was your recommendation of Delta / Seraphim panel's

We would not hesitate to recommend Advanced Solar Technology.After receiving four quotes, we chose AST from the Solar Quotes list. Not the cheapest but Alex was the only rep. to attend our site and discover what would have been a problem removing our existing system. His explanations and advice assisted us in making the final decision. The install was slightly ahead of the expected date and there were no problems. Grid connection was done at time of install and a new smart meter was installed by Western Power the following day. All paperwork required by Synergy was completed by AST. The clean up and removal of old panels was as promised. The monitoring app install was a little trickier and proved to be caused by discreet security settings in our router. Alex gladly sorted this.

Getting our solar system was a great experience.  The sales person was open and honest with us about what was actually achievable and what we could expect.  Then the delivery wen much smoother and quicker than expected.  The installation on the day,  was by a very professional team, who clearly cared about the job they did.

Alex and Michelle and their solar installers made everything so incredibly easy from the quotes and type of solar panels/inverters to the install process - everything went very smoothly.Due to the Feb covid lockdown I initially had a Zoom meeting with Alex to discuss solar panels and what I was looking for with my solar install - this was very informative. Alex then came out to inspect the house and we decided on both north and west facing solar panels.Even though I was told there would be a 3 week wait for the install, 2 weeks later we had the panels and inverter up and running and it has been incredibly fun to see the amount of energy being produced each and every day!Very happy overall.

The Sales/quoting process was very good.The installation was punctual, and looks OK  (no broken tiles).Customer service was very good  -  had an update on the Delta inverter, (which was a problem with my Apple computer as I don't have a Smartphone), but the Manager helped out.

Sales/quoting was very good with a video hookup to ensure I purchase the best system for my needs.The installers arrived exactly when they said they would. They were very tidy taking all the packing away and finished the job in around 4 hours.The customer service has been very good with setting up the system and connecting to the grid, with a follow up phone call from them and a visit to check things. There is a problem with the wifi system and they are currently waiting for a new wifi circuit board to replace the existing one.

The quotation was done by phone & video link, as I was in self quarantine, which was ideal as I did not want to wait 2 weeks to get the process started. The video link provided the oportunity to get answers to many questions imediately & for explanation of the reasons for the siting of the equipment that had been suggested. The other 2 suppliers also did their quotes using aerial photos of my property & phone conversations, at my request not theirs, as all 3 would have preferred a face to face consultation. The quotes were presented very punctually from all 3 solar installation companies.The installation was done very quickly after accepting the quote & paying the deposit. The installers turned up on time (in fact a little earlier in the day than expected) & completed the job promptly. They were polite & respected social distancing rules from us & left everything clean/neat & tidy.We were replacing a 10 year old solar system so did not need help connecting to the grid but they did have to remove the old panels & inverter as part of the install, which again was completed satisfactorily.The owner of the business came to inspect the installation as they were finishing the job & spent time explaining the digital inverter read out & advised I could contact him any time for explanations on any aspect of the solar equipment or install which I would feel comfortable doing.All 3 quotes were similar in price but had diffent equipment supplies (no point if they are all the same, so apart from the extra warranty on the inverter I went with the company I felt most comfortable with & that I thought would give me the best service & after care.

Alex and Michelle at Advanced Solar are a family run operation. This immediately drew me to them over the bigger companies where sales people care less about making sure you're happy than their commission. They were quick to respond and offered the best value.The installation was great and the installers were punctual and polite. The only issue is they put rubbish in the recycling bin and recycling in the normal bin which I had to remove and correct, but thats an honest mistake.After sales service was good too and Alex came over to show me the ropes however I was quite busy so couldn't discuss it for long with him.
Sales consultant was well informed and knew his products well. Installation was arranged within a timely manner and everything went smoothly and to schedule.
Everything from the quotation to the installation & followup training on how to receive the maximum benefit of the system. Very happy with every aspect.

Advanced Solar were quick to respond and came out to discuss my requirements. They accommodated my preference for how the inverter should be installed, advised me on the most efficient layout for the panels, provided great insights and advice on what to expect and how to get the best out of my system. The installation was flawless and I'm a fussy customer - there was nothing left for me to clean up after they had left. The team took great care and were happy to answer my questions - not rushed just trying to get done. They ran through the system with me once it was installed and walked me through the  menu options and functions.   They installed a PowerPal energy monitor which is a great little device for monitoring my consumption. Everything was done on time and I was never left second guessing what to expect next. They took care of everything from start to finish, all I had to do was place the order, provide a copy of my electricity account and settle the account once I was happy with everything. After having contacted numerous solar system providers I was pleasantly surprised by what Solarquotes had to offer with respect to what amounted to accredited supplier/installers. Alex from Advanced called at our home and explained in detail what he was offering and the options available to us based on our system requirements.System was installed in January 2017 which was earlier than promised so that was all good. Installation team had system installed in no time at all and provided basic system instruction and procedure in the event of a problem. They completed a neat installation and took care of all packaging etc. All well and good.However, and no fault of the installer the system had no sooner been commissioned and it went into alarm with a  notification that the Inverter was Over Voltage Range! Installer suggested we call Western Power as this was their responsibility to adjust grid voltage by "tapping it down".This was a situation I had not expected. I hadn't taken a cheaper quote ( of which I had ample opportunity), but considered that by paying a fair and reasonable price I would in return have the benefit of good and reliable service with equipment that will last the term. Having had the benefit in my working life of quoting end users and managing installation of electronic security products the knowledge that things do go wrong or that local environmental/geographical conditions can play a part, we always informed our customer of the fact that given local conditions they could expect certain adverse outcomes, which would be addressed at the time of commissioning.My wife and I do not recall being told that if the local grid supply is above a certain voltage the system will go into alarm. So hence my concerns which lead to a call to Alex who subsequently informed me that there had been a software/firmware upgrade to the Delta Inverters in October 2016 which caused the OVR situation and I would have to contact Western Power regarding a Tap Down of the grid voltage. Unit displayed 258Vac when in alarm. Western Power were very helpful and on 3RD February adjusted grid voltage down and solar system has been doing its job averaging just on 20,000Wh per day, all good.Now I have reviewed the documentation that came with the Inverter to see if there should be something else I need to be on the lookout for. In particular there are two Test Reports that came with the unit that state that unit passed. Interestingly enough I couldn't locate any information with respect to software or firmware versions or that the particular unit I have was upgraded/adjusted in October 2015 (as indicated by Alex). According to PV Inverter Test Report test date was 2015/12/6. Surely if box had been opened for modification of software/firmware, there should have been some documented notification included. Maybe Delta's QA/QC procedure needs reviewing?With regard to OVR test range for Australia the unit was tested at 265Vac+/-2% (270Vac Trip), yet at 258Vac unit went into alarm for OVR.All factors considered I have working system and once I have had two consecutive accounts from Synergy I will be able to see what the financial benefit has been.I have recommended your services and those of Advanced Technology to colleagues who I am aware are in the market for Solar power in the future and trust they will place their business with you.Thank for following up on our installation, and that if what I have provided is of interest and can improve outcomes for future clients that will be a benefit to us all.With respect to LED lighting I have requested a quotation from local lighting suppliers for my requirements and that should in time reflect a further saving.Thanks Finn, appreciate your professional service.
